headline: On November 8, 2017: Louvre Abu Dhabi opened
captionCards: 24,000 square metres in size – largest art museum in the Arabian Peninsula
France’s largest cultural project abroad under a 2007 agreement
instagramCaption:
Louvre Abu Dhabi opened on November 8, 2017.

The museum was inaugurated by French President Emmanuel Macron and Abu Dhabi's then-crown prince Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

Located on Saadiyat Island, it spans 24,000 square metres with 8,000 square metres of galleries—making it the largest art museum in the Arabian Peninsula.

It is France’s largest cultural project abroad under a 2007 agreement allowing use of the Louvre name until 2047.

Today, it stands as a cornerstone of Abu Dhabi’s Saadiyat Cultural District, promoting cross-cultural dialogue through global art.
